sources.label: 🧩 Android patches for Viber, BeReal, MovieBox, Proton Mail, Proton VPN, TeraBox
sources.author: hxreborn
patch_list: Removes Quip cards and the Quip button, and stops feed videos from autoplaying or preloading.
Disables Amplitude, AppsFlyer, Sentry, Sift and Mux data collection.
Removes the Home tab and starts on Memberships. Accounts without memberships keep the tab.
Removes chosen tabs from the bottom bar.
Limits Home to creators you're a member of.
Removes suggested creators and topics from Explore.
Removes upgrade, rejoin and gift banners, upsell sheets, social proof and the in-feed survey.
Removes the rating prompt and the in-app update prompt.
